sentiment: The wheel keeps turning whether we believe in it or not — and there is a strange comfort in orbiting something larger than ourselves.

stories.title: A Physicist Rigged His Pet Hamster's Wheel to Upload to Strava
stories.summary: Someone put a hamster wheel on Strava. The absurdity is the point — we all orbit something, and at least the hamster is honest about it.

stories.title: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers
stories.summary: When the orbit loses its meaning, the wheel still turns — but we start to feel the weight of what we once believed in.

stories.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
stories.summary: A model that runs fast and cheap — another orbit in the endless loop of faster, better, cheaper.
